name: Futatsu-me no Ayo
source:
Kagehisa Kibitsu awoke in an unknown Eastern room.
Not alone. Eight other people were similarly regaining their bearings.

Where is this.
How did I get here.

A letter in the room addressed the bewildered nine.

"You will fight demons."

Will you proceed? Will you survive? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE103680.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
吉备津影弥在一间陌生的东方风格房间里醒来。
他并非独自一人。还有另外八个人，也在逐渐弄清自己的处境。

这是哪里？
我是怎么来到这里的？

房间里的一封信，向困惑的九人传达了一句话。

“你们将与恶鬼战斗。”

你会继续前进吗？你能活下来吗？

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE103680.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
